name: HashiCorp Consul
description: Lists what is registered in a Consul service catalog: the nodes become hosts (with their address and whether the agent is alive) and every registered service instance becomes a guest of its node, with its health (passing, warning or critical), tags and port. Netlens ties the nodes and services to the devices it found by address. Read-only: it only sends GET requests.
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: Talks to the device through Netlens' shared HTTP client (certificate and host name checks, timeouts, size limit and redirect rules are the same in every plugin). Needs Netlens 0.4.366 or newer. No change in what the plugin reads or writes.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
